_comment: Use this file to add non-Credly / non-Microsoft credentials (e.g. Linux Foundation, CNCF, Cisco, University degrees).

_instructions.displayed: Set to false to hide this card from the CV grid (default: true).
_instructions.includeInCount: Set to false to exclude from the headline badge counter (default: true).
_instructions.priority: Higher numbers appear first on the page (default: 0). E.g., 10 floats to top; -1 pushes to bottom.
_instructions.order: Alternative to priority: order: 1 = 1st place, order: 2 = 2nd place.
_instructions.badgeImageUrl: Public image or SVG URL (e.g. https://... or /assets/...). If left blank, a fallback icon is used.
